draft.title: Components of blood
card: Blood is made of cells and a liquid. The cells are red blood cells, white blood cells and platelets. The liquid is plasma.
They carry oxygen around the body. They hold a protein called haemoglobin, which binds to oxygen.
White blood cells fight infection. Platelets help blood to clot, which closes a cut and slows bleeding.
The pale yellow liquid part of blood. It carries nutrients and wastes, and also carries the blood cells.
draft.remember: Red cells carry oxygen, white cells defend, platelets clot and plasma carries nutrients and wastes.

a.q: Aisha cuts her knee in a netball game and the bleeding slows after a few minutes. Which part of the blood mainly helped?
a.why: Platelets help blood to clot, which closes the cut and slows bleeding. White blood cells are the most tempting wrong answer, but they fight infection rather than seal the wound.
a.clue: Which part helps blood to clot?

b.q: Tom trains at a high altitude camp in Falls Creek, and his body makes more red blood cells. What is the direct benefit of having more of them?
opts: More oxygen can be carried to his muscles
More infections can be fought off
More wastes can be dissolved in the plasma
b.why: Red blood cells carry oxygen, so having more of them lets the blood carry more oxygen to working muscles. Fighting infection is the job of white blood cells, and clotting is the job of platelets.
b.clue: Match the job to the cell type that has more of it.

b.best: More oxygen can be carried to his muscles
